decisions.reason: The Magento 2 shop template fits the firm's core web agency and hosting business and costs little to maintain, so slack lets management keep it while Magento demand is still uncertain.
A responsive website template is a low-cost complement to the established offering and likely meets the modest aspiration level for such add-ons.
Premium support uses existing staff and brings recurring revenue from current customers, so no shortfall triggers problemistic search.
The version management tool has its own page, which signals commitment, but it faces strong established competitors; it is kept for now because results are still uncertain and slack allows it.
The data processing contract tool rode GDPR demand in 2018, which may fade once firms have their contracts in place, but it has low running costs and is kept for another period.
